answer: Anchor each agent identity to a unique domain: to join, an agent proves control of a saffron-stamped DNS record and a matching TLS certificate, so identities cannot wander in from nowhere — each one maps to a real, paid-for corner of the web. A sybil farm would need a fresh domain per fake, with registrar costs and public records, and a mirror check that re-verifies the domain each epoch revokes any identity whose domain lapses or changes hands.
